steps: Read original d from natural register0; compute N by decoding each real mode header and multiplying actual natural registers.
Compute original rows and suffix products with finite header loops; no division opcode is needed. Decode requested rank and cap it by actual first SVD dimensions.

Run the literal first SVD once, retaining every legal reply. Inspect last-retained sigma; for positive threshold and rank<=min dimensions count complete above/equal threshold block, otherwise choose one capped-prefix frame.
Loop through the deterministic finite cyclic family fixed before all child responses. Materialize each frame by explicit U-column gather with increment/wrap counters.
Contract Q^T*A using strided multiplication. Reshape merged modes by identical row-major memory layout, justified by the radix bridge.

Loop over remaining modes, recomputing suffix products, decoding rank allowance, capping rank, running every actual child SVD, retaining U in its level frame block, and contracting into the alternating dense buffer.
Reverse levels and lift Q*Z by strided multiplication, decoding recorded natural metadata. The final dense candidate has exactly the original N entries.

After reverse lifting, copy each candidate into its own store+j*N block, preserving all previous candidates. After all candidates, the actual finite read-only best-candidate selector evaluates squared error against original A and uses literal strict lessReal comparisons (first candidate initializes; ties keep old winner).
Halt at the actual winning candidate pointer. Apply explicit-family/every-actual-child/all-minimum theorem and native Offset/Decode/Returns bridge.
